gene_notes.AP5B1: Returned April 3 is the issue date. First journal publication March 12 is explicitly recorded in PDF p.18. Preserve March 12 as the located public article date.

gene_notes.CREB3: July 17, 2025 is verified journal online publication. A retrospective author-program record describes target presentations in May/July 2024. Keep the frozen interval 2024-05-01 to 2025-07-17. The old displayed May 1 was not an exact verified day.
gene_notes.CRLS1: Acceptance February 6 is distinct from advance access February 11, 2022. Returned October 8 is unsupported. PubMed gives the issue date October 28, 2022. Use February 11 for the located public article date.

gene_notes.DHRSX: Both returned dates are valid events: online May 30 and issue July 11, 2024. A June 10 online correction is separate. First-public timing remains May 30.
gene_notes.DNAJC30: Acceptance January 14, 2021 is not public release. Publisher version history supports January 19 in-press preview, before March 15 final electronic publication.

gene_notes.GPATCH11: The target preprint was public August 21, 2023, before journal receipt October 9. Journal acceptance November 13 and publication November 21, 2024 are later events. DOI August 19 is not the posting day.
gene_notes.INTS11: Both returned dates are valid: online April 12, issue May 4, 2023. Use April 12 for the located public article date.
gene_notes.KCNJ16: Online April 2 precedes June 1, 2021 issue. The supplied PDF is only a two-page extract. Receipt/acceptance and exact online date were checked in fresh PubMed XML, not inferred from this limited PDF.
gene_notes.LIG3: Advance access April 15, 2021 precedes June 22 issue. Accepted December 9, 2020 does not establish pre-cutoff public availability.
gene_notes.MRPL49: Public preprint October 11, 2024 precedes online March 4 and issue April 3, 2025. Earlier thesis award year 2022 and submission January 2023 do not establish public deposit. Keep frozen interval 2022-01-01 to 2024-10-11.

gene_notes.PLCG1: Separate 2023 immune report (online July 6, issue November) from sensory target preprint January 9, 2024, reviewed preprint April 19, 2024 and Version of Record August 27, 2025. Returned August 17 has no support in checked sources.
gene_notes.RFC4: August 5, 2024 is the online publication date in the PDF history. September 5 is the issue date.

gene_notes.RNU6-2: January 6, 2025 is the shared retinal preprint. January 9, 2026 is journal online. A filename is not an independent publication or a separate validation.
gene_notes.RNU6-8: January 6, 2025 is the shared retinal preprint. January 9, 2026 is journal online. A filename is not an independent publication or a separate validation.
